args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding but round_money was
using ROUND_HALF_UP, breaking the nightly build. Switch the
quantize call to ROUND_HALF_EVEN to match the documented behavior.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was implemented with ROUND_HALF_UP.

## Changes
- Switch `round_money().quantize()` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the existing docstring's documented behavior. No other code changes.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

This is a minimal fix intended for today's release. Review appreciated! :rocket:
